summary: Urban Outfitters filed an 8-K solely to disclose its second quarter fiscal 2026 earnings release, reporting record sales and profits. The filing contains routine operational results—net sales up 10.4% to $1.66 billion, EPS of $2.78—and no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital action. No deal terms, premium, or strategic review are mentioned. The 8-K is a standard earnings disclosure under Item 8.01, with no corporate action requiring special-situations classification. What to watch: normal quarterly performance metrics and any forward guidance in the release.
